defect.observed: logics artifact validation failed: ValueError: Missing or external parser image: imgs/img_in_image_box_328_184_402_240.jpg
defect.root_cause: The Logics-Parsing-V3 worker emits synthetic HTML placeholders inside table cells for regions it never crops to files. Those files are absent from the shipped assets (real figures ship as images/page_XXXX_figure_N_0.png). validate_document rejected any markdown image reference not in the declared asset set.
defect.secondary: The remote worker runs its own copy of the shared normalizer at /models/model_artifact.py and validates before publishing, so the same stale copy also failed the job worker-side.

fix.summary: Added _strip_unavailable_images(): for the logics backend only, drops HTML/Markdown image references whose resolved path is not a declared, hash-verified asset, then regenerates blocks and appends a structured warning {code: LOGICS_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE, unavailable_count, unavailable_images}. Declared references are never dropped; fenced code blocks and srcset violations are left untouched so existing security checks keep rejecting them. Security invariants (traversal, remote URLs, symlinks, hash/size verification) and the every-referenced-image-is-declared invariant for mineru/teleocr are unchanged.
fix.not_changed: No second OpenViking source file required. The deploy-side copy deploy/parser-models/model_artifact.py is out of the assigned footprint and was NOT edited in the repo; the live worker's /models/model_artifact.py was updated only to execute the real end-to-end run (backup kept at /models/model_artifact.py.bak-20261004).
